中间穿深色外套的男子

title.zh: 看着我们的她

text.zh: 前景的女子转过头，直直地看着画外的我们。
text.en: The woman in the foreground turns her head and looks straight out at us.

title.zh: 两个穿外套的男人

text.zh: 她身边的两位男子穿着当时巴黎的日常服装，正在聊天。当时的观众看到这样的组合，非常吃惊。
text.en: The two men beside her wear the everyday clothes of contemporary Paris, deep in conversation. Viewers at the time were shocked by the combination.

title.zh: 野餐

text.zh: 左下角是一个倒翻的篮子，水果和面包散落在脱下的衣服上，像一幅静物画。
text.en: At the lower left, an overturned basket spills fruit and bread onto discarded clothes, like a still life.

title.zh: 溪水里的女子

text.zh: 后面的小溪里，另一位女子弯着腰，好像在洗东西或者在戏水。
text.en: In the stream behind, another woman bends down, perhaps washing or bathing.

title.zh: 来自提香

text.zh: 题材借自卢浮宫的一幅古画《田园合奏》，当时被认为是乔尔乔内画的，现在认为出自提香。
text.en: The subject was borrowed from *The Pastoral Concert* in the Louvre, then thought to be by Giorgione and now attributed to Titian.

title.zh: 来自拉斐尔

text.zh: 前景三个人的姿势，来自一幅根据拉斐尔的画刻的古老版画。
text.en: The poses of the three figures in the foreground come from an old engraving after a work by Raphael.

title.zh: 模特维多琳

text.zh: 前景的女子由维多琳·默朗扮演，她是马奈常用的模特，后来自己也成了画家。
text.en: The woman in the foreground is Victorine Meurent, Manet's favourite model, who later became a painter herself.

compare._说明: 独家发现“马奈借了什么”：对比滑块，在三幅原作之间切换（都是真实原作，不加“这是示意”）。提香用 Wikimedia Commons 的 PD-Art 版本；莱蒙迪的版画用大都会博物馆开放资源（CC0，等 Tia 在大都会官网确认）。都等 Tia 上传。

note.zh: 题材来自提香，姿势来自拉斐尔，衣服来自马奈的巴黎。这里每一幅都是原作。
note.en: The subject from Titian, the poses from Raphael, the clothes from Manet's Paris. Every image here is an original.

alt.en: Édouard Manet, Luncheon on the Grass, 1863, Musée d'Orsay, Paris

title.zh: 第一幕 · 落选者沙龙

text.zh: 1863年，官方沙龙拒绝了这幅画。同一年，皇帝拿破仑三世下令为落选作品开办了一个展览。马奈以《沐浴》为名展出了它，结果成了整个展览最受关注的作品，引来了嘲笑，也引发了丑闻。
text.en: In 1863, the official Salon rejected this painting. That same year, Emperor Napoleon III ordered an exhibition for rejected works. Manet showed it there under the title *The Bath*, and it became the main attraction, drawing laughter and scandal.

alt.zh: 马奈《草地上的午餐》1863，巴黎奥赛博物馆
alt.en: Édouard Manet, Luncheon on the Grass, 1863, Musée d'Orsay, Paris

title.zh: 第二幕 · 向大师致敬

text.zh: 人们没有注意到的是，马奈其实是在向古代大师致敬：题材借自提香，人物姿势借自拉斐尔。他只是把古老的题材，放进了现代人的衣服里。
text.en: What people failed to notice was that Manet was paying tribute to the old masters: the subject came from Titian, the poses from Raphael. He simply dressed an ancient theme in modern clothes.

alt.zh: 马奈《草地上的午餐》1863，巴黎奥赛博物馆
alt.en: Édouard Manet, Luncheon on the Grass, 1863, Musée d'Orsay, Paris

title.zh: 第三幕 · 现代艺术的起点
title.en: A starting point of modern art

text.zh: 1867年，马奈把画名改成了《草地上的午餐》。今天，它被看作现代艺术的起点之一，收藏在奥赛博物馆。
text.en: In 1867, Manet renamed it *Le Déjeuner sur l'herbe*. Today it is seen as one of the starting points of modern art, and hangs in the Musée d'Orsay.

final.zh: 一场野餐，成了现代艺术的起点。
final.en: A picnic that became a starting point of modern art.
